subject: Demo timing during re:Invent week — need to move

Cc: acme-sales@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Need to shift our demo — attending re:Invent the week of Nov 29

Hi Monica,

Apologies for the short notice — our data platform team just confirmed travel to re:Invent the week of Nov 29 and several people planned for the demo (including our CTO) will be unavailable. We had the session scheduled for Tue Nov 30 at 11am PT.

Can we move the demo to the following week? Preferably Dec 6–10, mornings PT. If that's not possible, could you send a short recording of the run-through we can share with the team in the meantime?

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Analytics

Hi Liam — thanks for flagging this. Totally understand — re:Invent week is hectic.

We can absolutely move. Jordan, Priya — can you confirm availability for the week of Dec 6? Liam, I can pencil you in for Tue Dec 7 or Thu Dec 9 at 10am PT (both slots are currently open on our side).

In the meantime, I recorded a concise 12-minute walkthrough of the flow you requested and uploaded it to Drive (link below). It covers the integration surface and the live routing/fallback behavior that Matt asked about. If you want a version with your sample data, we can do that as a short follow-up.

I'll attach the latest deck and send an updated calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Best,
